answer: Resist sybils with zero-knowledge identity credentials: each real operator passes a one-time ceremony and gets a credential tied to a secret nullifier. Acting on-chain means publishing the nullifier plus a ZK proof of a valid credential, the lantern glowing while the face stays hidden. A nullifier is saffron-rare: single-use per context, so one credential means one vote forever. Ten thousand fake votes need ten thousand ceremonies, each demanding a distinct documented, live-checked human. Forging sybils becomes sable-dark linear labor, while honest agents prove at near-zero cost.
